violations.message: [Rule: no_wildcard_action] Statement (Sid: 'AllowCICDDeployments') permits wildcard (*) Action. Over-privileged access violates least privilege.
[Rule: no_wildcard_resource] Statement (Sid: 'AllowCICDDeployments') permits unrestricted Resource ('*'). Resources must be explicitly scoped by ARN.

gemma_audit.threat_explanation: This policy grants high-risk administrative and privilege escalation capabilities. Combining iam:PassRole, iam:CreateAccessKey, and iam:PutUserPolicy allows an entity to attach arbitrary administrative policies to users or generate new credentials to escalate privileges across the account.
combination_risks: iam:PassRole + iam:CreateAccessKey + iam:PutUserPolicy enables full account privilege escalation (attaching inline admin policies and generating persistent credentials).
